en.p: There are 15 balls and three empty boxes $\mathrm{A}$, $\mathrm{B}$, $\mathrm{C}$. Using one die, the following trial of putting balls into the three boxes is performed according to the rule below.

box: If the number rolled is a multiple of 3, put 1, 2, 0 balls into boxes $\mathrm{A}$, $\mathrm{B}$, $\mathrm{C}$, respectively;
if it is not a multiple of 3, put 1, 1, 1 balls into boxes $\mathrm{A}$, $\mathrm{B}$, $\mathrm{C}$, respectively.

en.p: After repeating this trial 5 times, given that the number of balls in box $\mathrm{B}$ is odd, what is the probability that the total number of balls in boxes $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{C}$ is at least 8? [4 points]
